full_text:
The City of Atlantis (titled La città di Atlantide in Italy) is a gamebook written by Frank J. Martucci, based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was published by Fabbri Editori and released in Italy on November 25, 2009. It was planned to be followed by The Showdown. The story is written from the perspective of Lok Lambert, whose actions along the journey are decided by the reader.

Synopsis

Lok, together with his friends from the Huntik Foundation, is about to embark on a new adventure, which will take him into the depths of the sea to the gates of the city of Atlantis, on the traces of his father and the legendary Amulet of Will. But this time you, the reader, will take on the role of the young Seeker and choose for him. Because this is a book, where adventure combines with play and fun: whenever you find yourself at a crossroads, it's up to you to decide which direction to take. You will have to fight, solve puzzles, choose whether to help your teammates or go on alone. And the outcome of the mission will depend on you...

Trivia

• The gamebook is based on the events of the Season 1 episodes The Unseen Guide and Coming of Age.
• As the reader decides what steps to Lok should take on the journey, many events of the story deviate from that of the TV episodes. One such example is the inclusion of Sea Freelancer, the Atlantean equivalent of Freelancer, who does not appear in the original episode and is summoned by the Mermen. In order to defeat them, Lok orders his own Freelancer to attack him.

'''''The City of Atlantis''''' (titled '''''La città di Atlantide''''' in Italy) is a gamebook written by [[Frank J. Martucci]], based on ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]''. It was published by Fabbri Editori and released in Italy on November 25, 2009. It was planned to be followed by ''[[The Showdown]]''. The story is written from the perspective of [[Lok Lambert]], whose actions along the journey are decided by the reader. 

== Synopsis ==
[[Lok]], together with his friends from the [[Huntik Foundation]], is about to embark on a new adventure, which will take him into the depths of the sea to the gates of the city of [[Atlantis]], on the traces of his [[Eathon Lambert|father]] and the legendary [[Amulet of Will]]. But this time you, the reader, will take on the role of the young Seeker and choose for him. Because this is a book, where adventure combines with play and fun: whenever you find yourself at a crossroads, it's up to you to decide which direction to take. You will have to fight, solve puzzles, choose whether to help your teammates or go on alone. And the outcome of the mission will depend on you...

== Trivia ==
*The gamebook is based on the events of the Season 1 episodes ''[[The Unseen Guide]]'' and ''[[Coming of Age]]''.
* As the reader decides what steps to Lok should take on the journey, many events of the story deviate from that of the TV episodes. One such example is the inclusion of [[Sea Freelancer]], the Atlantean equivalent of [[Freelancer]], who does not appear in the original episode and is summoned by the [[Mermen]]. In order to defeat them, Lok orders his own Freelancer to attack him.
